Zapret 2 v1.0.6, unmodified upstream Windows binaries and Lua scripts.
Upstream commit: 221d7dff24bfec0cd5ac0a5070b8acef2008af3d
Downloaded archive (also contains engine source and build instructions):
https://github.com/bol-van/zapret2/releases/download/v1.0.6/zapret2-v1.0.6.zip
Archive SHA256: e141b51b60c895fe9548f4d644365461dcad8155e068d284a9aae1724504237d

Included runtime versions from that archive:
- x86 Cygwin 3.3.6; x86_64 Cygwin 3.4.10, unmodified DLLs.
  Source: https://cygwin.com/git.html
  Source mirror: https://github.com/mirror/newlib-cygwin
  Licensing: https://www.cygwin.com/licensing.html
- WinDivert DLL and driver, unmodified upstream bundled versions.
  Source/build instructions: https://github.com/basil00/WinDivert

Keep the licenses/ directory with redistributed copies. The tray application
runs winws2.exe as a separate process; its own license does not replace these
components' licenses. No upstream batch file or service installer is run.

App profiles target HTTP/TLS on TCP 80/443 and do not change Windows DNS settings.
The Superonline TLS preset uses multidisorder:pos=2:seqovl=1, as used by:
https://github.com/alimali54/zapret-win-turkey/blob/master/zapret-win-turkey.au3
The separate Superonline TCP profile additionally drops outbound QUIC Initial
packets on UDP 443 for applications that can fall back to TCP. It does not
implement Discord voice handling. These presets need testing on the user's line.
